title: adapter MANIFEST.json
description: A registered adapter: `/srv/pinka/models/adapters/<name>/<sha256>/MANIFEST.json`, written by the GPU arbiter when a training run succeeds, root-owned and read-only. Deployment specs name the adapter as `<name>@<sha256>` in `adapter_ids`.

sha256.description: The adapter hash (see files); the directory name.

base_model_id.description: Model id (models.lock.yml) of the base model the adapter was trained on; null for a job without a base model. vLLM serves the adapter only with this model.

run.description: The training run that produced it.

path.description: Path relative to the adapter's directory, with / separators and no leading ./; UTF-8 without control characters or backslashes, so its line is unambiguous.

files.description: Every regular file of the adapter, sorted by the path's UTF-8 bytes (as `LC_ALL=C sort` sorts, whatever the locale); the adapter hash is the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the UTF-8 lines `<sha256>  <path>` of this list (lowercase hex, two spaces, the path), each ending in a newline (the output format of `sha256sum`).
